prerequisites.old_primary_requirement: Only complete old primaries for the requested replacement parts, each checked against the original summary. Part 0 has 37 original complete mean panels. The unpushed/lost old R77 output is not an input.
prerequisites.new_numerical_chain: PM true physical moments -> PA full physical candidate audit -> CA only additional integral -> CF full carrier audit -> formal comparison; every actual exit and hash remains mandatory.

exact_consumption.positive_mass: omega=I00+I01=integral w dr. Intersect only with Delta_r*w enclosure of the same integral, not with a different candidate residual.
exact_consumption.original_mean: For each new true leaf take the maximum of the already certified complete mean root bounds on all intersecting old source leaves; verify those leaves cover it.
exact_consumption.mean_derivative_units: Old c_x is divided by its certified positive r_x. PA/CF already differentiate in physical r, with radius_x=1.
exact_consumption.mean_constant: Fix one common left height. All cumulative differences thereafter remain one signed integral, enclosed symmetrically; the final shift persists through unchanged later pieces.
exact_consumption.six_jets: PA/CF full height, r, rr, theta, rtheta, thetatheta; retains complete c and c_r and all 20 nonmean modes.
exact_consumption.scope_limit: No new exact outer solution, spatial immersion, held ratio, reach, automatic replacement, or signed mean cancellation is claimed.
